opening.argument: The speaker promotes an opportunity requiring viewers to invest money while claiming they can double or triple it and earn without doing anything: "You actually invest money. You can double, triple, you know, who knows where this will go in the next year. But you can make money with without doing absolutely anything." The pitch also depends on recruiting through a two-sided network, where "everybody that goes in will go left or right," and a shared link places new participants into the speaker's group: "if this is sent to someone they will be automatically in your group." After presenting investment and token-value growth claims, the speaker urges viewers, "Please get on board." Together, these features present paid participation and referral-based recruitment as a way to make money passively.
